sv.title: EU: Coca-Cola är för dyr – utreder
sv.summary: En formell utredning om misstänkt konkurrensbrott av Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) – en stor aktör i grossistledet inom läskedryckshanteringen i Europa – har inletts av EU-kommissionen.

en.title: EU: Coca-Cola is too expensive – investigating
en.summary: A formal investigation into suspected competition violations by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) – a major wholesale player in soft drink distribution in Europe – has been opened by the European Commission.
